correctness.rationale: All possible support patterns of the two exposed faces form four exhaustive disjoint classes. Face dimensions are proved by independent signed simplex directions or their shared-coordinate hyperplane. Inclusion-exclusion yields the polynomial, and polar analysis yields the irredundant facets. All boundary values p=0, q=0, r=0 and n=1 are included. Independent exact rational enumeration matches every admissible p,q,r with n<=5 (45 triples); finite checks only corroborate the general proof.

value.rationale: This proves a nontrivial natural complete family case of a recent explicitly posed face-enumeration problem: the exact f-vector in every dimension for all support overlaps, a sharp facet/vertex count, polar facet inequalities and invariance under positive summand weights. The result is not a routine scalar substitution and gives usable combinatorial structural information missing from known Ehrhart/volume formulas.
